lines.text: main goal. If indeed an SCV is not going to be leading the Reaper, there's a
chance that the Reaper will move straight across the map. The Zerglings will
take a detour and try to stop the opponent from building a command center.
This command center is important because the Terran wants to grow the economy.
The players also need to protect the supply line while they expand.
The first worker is moving toward the natural expansion.
A group of marines is guarding the entrance to the base.
The scouting unit has spotted the new building on the other side of the map.
The next attack will arrive before the defensive upgrade is finished.
The defending player needs to keep those workers alive.
The camera is now moving back to the main base.
Both players have enough resources to produce another group of units.
The army is waiting at the narrow passage near the center.
The small units can move quickly around the edge of the map.
The second command center will increase the income from workers.
There is no need to chase the enemy into that defensive position.
The supply count is still close even after the previous battle.
One player is preparing another attack while the other builds defenses.
The next few seconds will decide whether this expansion survives.
The defending army has finally arrived to protect the new base.

response: [34] 主要目标。如果那台SCV不会负责指挥Reaper的话，那么Reaper很可能会直接穿过地图。而Zerglings则会选择绕路，试图阻止对手建造指挥中心。[35] 这个指挥中心非常重要，因为人类玩家希望以此来发展自己的经济实力。[36] 在扩张的同时，玩家还需要保护好物资补给线。[37] 第一名工兵正在向自然扩张区域前进。[38] 有一群海军陆战队员在守卫着基地的入口处。[39] 侦察部队已经发现了地图另一侧的新建筑。[40] 下一次攻击将会在防御设施建成之前到来。[41] 防御方玩家必须让那些工兵活下来。[42] 目前，摄像机正在返回主基地。[43] 两名玩家都拥有足够的资源来再制造一批军队。[44] 军队正在中心附近的狭窄通道处等待着。[45] 小型部队可以快速移动到地图的边缘地带。[46] 第二个指挥中心能够提升工兵带来的收入。[47] 没有必要将敌人逼入那种防御阵地中。[48] 即使经历了之前的战斗，双方的物资数量仍然相差不大。[49] 一名玩家正在准备再次发动攻击，而另一名玩家则在构筑防御工事。[50] 接下来的几秒钟将决定这次扩张能否成功。[51] 防御方军队终于赶来保护新的基地了。
